interview.name: Noah
interview.answer: It’s being held around the school pickup window, and Jules is organizing it.

reflections: Noah is responsive and wants to stay informed, but needs clearer timing to avoid missing group plans.
Vik is coordinating the repair drive and is acting as the central organizer for sharing details.
Bo is interested in helping and is asking practical questions to find an easy way to join in.

events.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What did I miss?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Vik: Not much yet — we’re just getting folks lined up for the repair drive. I’ll repeat the plan to everyone once we’ve got the details set.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Noah: Got it — thanks for looping me in. Just let me know when the details are set and I’ll try not to miss it again.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive about?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Noah: Oh, it’s just folks pitching in with fixes around the neighborhood — I think there was talk of tools, maybe a sign-up sheet too.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Bo: Got it — I can probably help if there’s a simple fix. Where do I sign up?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks. Just let me know when the details are set and I’ll try not to miss it again.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Opal: Will do — I’m just finalizing the drop-off spot and the street coverage, then I’ll pass the details along.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out once you send it along.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Noah: Thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and the sign-up sheet.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll pass the details around as soon as they’re set, and I’ll make sure the sign-up sheet gets to everyone.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll watch for it and try to be ready when it goes around.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, Noah — I’ll confirm everything once I have them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — just let me know when you’ve got the details and I’ll keep an eye out.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Hana: Will do — I’ll update you as soon as I’ve confirmed everything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Hey Noah, are we still good for the repair drive this weekend? Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Noah: Yep, still good — I just need the details on the first fix. Let me know where to start and I’ll do my best not to miss it.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mina: Great — start with the loose shelf near the entrance, and I’ll grab the tools.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Noah: Yep, still good — just point me to the first fix and I’ll jump in.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Faye: Great — I’ll check our pickup timing and send you a window that works for us.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your pickup window.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still in — just point me to the first fix and I’ll get on it. I’m trying not to miss the details this time.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Great — I’ll make sure you get the first fix and I’ll keep everyone posted on the timing. If anything shifts, I’ll pass it along right away.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just tell me where to start, and I’ll keep an eye out for updates.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m probably missing a bit again. What’s the first thing I should fix, and when should I show up?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: Start with the first repair tasks, and I’m keeping them around the school pickup window. Show up then, and I’ll put you to work right away.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll be there around school pickup and start with the first repair tasks. Just point me to whatever needs fixing first.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still in — just point me to the first fix and I’ll get on it.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mina: Great — start with the leaky faucet in the kitchen. I’ll point you to the next one after that.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll start with the kitchen faucet now. Just let me know what’s next after that.
events.speaker: Noah
